episode_summary: Alex Maldonado shares insights on helping first-time and first-generation buyers navigate the home buying process, focusing on overcoming closing cost hurdles with seller credits. He also discusses optimizing Google business profiles for better visibility and leveraging bilingual marketing to tap into the Hispanic community. This episode is packed with actionable strategies for agents looking to enhance their lead generation and conversion tactics.
